# jevey


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

`jevey` is a wrapper for [TypeSafe’s Jev](https://docs.typesafe.ai/) API

## Install

``` bash
pip install jevey
```

## Getting started

``` python
from jevey import Client, Noul
n = Noul("is_bug", "Is the customer reporting a software defect?")
```
